run_w2vu_generate_cli: run wav2vec unsupervised inference on pre-processed audio data with a trained model using the CLI
run_main_function: run the main generation function to transcribe audio and compute WER with a loaded model
run_generate_function: run generation over a dataset using a decoder and models to produce transcriptions
review_UnsupGenerateConfig: review the UnsupGenerateConfig dataclass to understand decoder options and beam search parameters
review_DecoderType: review the DecoderType enum to see supported decoders including VITERBI, KENLM, FAIRSEQ, and KALDI
